heading: A centrepiece without equal
lead: For the great room, the library, the conservatory or the garden. An orrery is the rare object that rewards the first glance and the hundredth: guests gather around it, children ask how it works, and on quiet evenings it simply turns.
pointsHeading: Why an orrery belongs at home

points.title: Conversation, in motion
points.text: Nothing draws a room together like a solar system turning in its midst. It is art, instrument and talking point at once.

points.title: Indoors, or under the open sky
points.text: Set it beneath a vaulted ceiling, or in the garden inside a Celestial Pavilion built to weather the seasons.

points.title: An heirloom, made for your family
points.text: Every detail is chosen with you. Add the Planetary Controller and align the planets to a birthday, a wedding, the day a child was born.

startingPoint.heading: A starting point
startingPoint.text: One of the configurations we'd suggest for a home. Use it as inspiration, or as the first sketch of your own.

closing.heading: Imagine it in your home.
closing.text: Tell us about the room, or the garden, you have in mind.
